blocks.text: PR coordinators often juggle multiple client workspaces. You need to keep track of urgent journalist requests while monitoring internal team progress. Keep your sidebar clean by grouping related channels. Use the Quick Switcher with ⌘ + K to move between client channels without touching your mouse.
Essential Slack keyboard shortcuts for Mac

items: ⌘ + K: Open the Quick Switcher to find any conversation.
⌘ + F: Search for messages in the current channel.
Shift + Enter: Start a new line in your message without sending it.
⌘ + B: Bold your selected text for emphasis.

blocks.text: Learning these shortcuts saves you from repetitive mouse movements. You can press ⌘ + / at any time to see the full list of shortcuts available in your current version. If you are on macOS 14 or later, these shortcuts function exactly as expected.
Refining your search for past pitches

Finding an old media pitch or client approval is hard if you just use basic search. Use modifiers to narrow down results. Type from:username to find messages sent by a specific team member. Use in:channelname to limit your search to a specific project. You can also use has:link or has:file to find shared assets quickly.

Sometimes Slack on your Mac might feel sluggish or stop showing notifications. The first step is to clear your app cache. Go to the menu bar and select Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart. This often resolves minor glitches without needing a full reinstall. Always check that you are running the latest version of the app.
Staying focused during high pressure campaigns

PR work is reactive. You can easily get overwhelmed by constant pings. Use the Do Not Disturb mode to pause notifications during deep work sessions. You can set a schedule in your preferences or type /dnd in any message box to start a timer. This protects your time for drafting press releases or social media copy.

Use threads to keep conversations organized. When someone asks a question about a campaign, reply in a thread to keep the main channel clear. This makes it easier for others to follow the conversation later. You can open the threads view by clicking Threads in the top left or using the sidebar.

faq.question: How do I jump to a specific conversation in Slack on Mac?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + K to open the Quick Switcher, then type the name of the channel or person you want to visit.

faq.question: What is the best way to search for old files in Slack?
faq.answer: Use the search bar with modifiers like has:file or in:channelname to quickly filter through your history.

faq.question: How do I clear the cache if Slack is running slowly?
faq.answer: Go to Help > Troubleshooting > Clear Cache and Restart in the Slack menu bar.
